# Task Template

## Objective

What user or operational outcome are we trying to achieve?

## Non-goals

What is explicitly out of scope for this task?

## Scope

- Areas of the app or docs affected
- Main routes, components, or content sources touched
- External systems or env vars involved

## Acceptance Criteria

- Main user or operator outcome
- Primary CTA or main-path behavior
- Error, empty, or fallback behavior
- Desktop and mobile expectations for UI work
- Operational visibility or safe-failure behavior when relevant

## Verification

- Commands to run
- Manual flows to test
- Devices or breakpoints to check
- Env, auth, or fallback scenarios to verify when relevant
- Evidence to capture or intentional skips to note

## Risks and Assumptions

- Missing infrastructure
- Temporary compromises
- Follow-up dependencies
